verdict.rationale: LangSmith's docs show it can ingest OpenTelemetry traces from any OTel-compatible application, including routing through an OpenTelemetry Collector with fanout. A community reply also confirms the OTel integration. The evidence covers only sending traces into LangSmith over OpenTelemetry; nothing shows LangSmith exporting or emitting its traces over OTLP to other backends, so the 'receive' half of the story is unproven. Missing for 10: documented OTLP export of LangSmith traces to external consumers, explicit OTLP endpoint/protocol details (HTTP vs gRPC), and hands-on corroboration of OTLP ingestion depth.

support.subject: As a developer, I can send and receive traces over OpenTelemetry (OTLP) instead of a proprietary format

citations.quote: LangSmith supports OpenTelemetry-based tracing, allowing you to send traces from any OpenTelemetry-compatible application.
an OpenTelemetry Collector, which batches and routes them to one or more destinations simultaneously (fanout).
